environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). The ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The application is exposed on port 443 via the ALB to internal corporate network (10.0.0.0/8). API keys are distributed to multiple internal teams for inventory queries.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS with ACM cert
